title: Tech Note: Handle Date and Time through 4D Mobile
version: 14.x (demos require Wakanda Enterprise 10 and 4D v14 R5+)
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note is entirely scoped to the original 4D Mobile + Wakanda architecture, which has since been fully discontinued and replaced by ORDA-based REST and Qodly tooling; the date/time impedance mismatch it addresses (single JS Date vs. separate 4D Date/Time fields) is a real, still-relevant conceptual issue when bridging 4D to JSON/JS clients, but the specific Wakanda-based mechanics described no longer apply to current 4D development.
related_updates: 4D Mobile and Wakanda both fully discontinued
ORDA REST APIs now handle date/time serialization to JSON directly
The underlying date/time modeling mismatch between 4D and JS remains a general integration consideration
